game_concept: A adventure race set in Snowy Hold – Skating Pond, a frozen skating pond: the firewood keeper must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Parameter Potion: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions.
theme: Snowy Hold – Skating Pond: a frozen skating pond
core_gameplay_loop: In Skating Pond, repeat each round: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the firewood keeper ahead. Then check the potions value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the chapel bell by solving code steps involving potions that move the firewood keeper forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.65).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the chapel bell first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Parameter Potion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Parameter Potion' (Week 6 slot 2), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Skating Pond'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Skating Pond.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.65).
